site.name: Your Tech Lab
site.tagline: Build your PC and explore your network with an assistant that explains problems and helps you fix them.

hero.heading: Your Tech Lab
hero.subheading: Build your PC and explore your network with an assistant that explains problems and helps you fix them.

pc.title: Build a PC
pc.description: Select real components, assemble them step by step, and learn what makes a computer work.

network.title: Explore Networks
network.description: Connect routers, build cables, configure addresses, and trace packets through your virtual network.

projects.title: My Projects
projects.subtitle: Continue Learning
projects.intro: Projects you save as a guest are kept on this device, in this browser.

empty.heading: No saved projects yet
empty.body: When you save work in a lab, it shows up here. Pick a lab to start.

unavailable.heading: This browser won't open local storage
unavailable.body: Storage may be blocked or full. Private windows often block it. Nothing was deleted.

error.heading: Couldn't load your projects
error.body: Something failed while reading them. Nothing was deleted.

corrupt.heading: {count, plural, one {# saved project can't be read} other {# saved projects can't be read}}
corrupt.body: The saved data is damaged. It was left on this device and not deleted.

confirm.heading: Delete this project?
confirm.body: The project and its saved snapshots will be removed from this device. You can't undo this.
confirm.failed: Couldn't delete the project. Try again.

archived.heading: {count, plural, one {# archived programming project} other {# archived programming projects}}
archived.body: Code Studio is no longer part of Your Tech Lab. Projects you made there are kept on this device exactly as you saved them. They can't be opened here, but you can download one as a JSON file or delete it.
archived.exportFailed: Couldn't read this project to export it. Nothing was changed.

settings.title: Settings

sound.label: Sound
sound.hint: Off until you turn it on.

robot.label: Show the robot
robot.hint: Text help stays when the robot is hidden.

settings.notSaved: Couldn't save this setting. This browser may be blocking storage.

frameRate.hint: Steadier on slower devices. Movements take the same time.

notFound.heading: Page not found
notFound.body: This address doesn't match any page here.

error.heading: Something went wrong on this page
error.body: Your saved projects were not touched. Try again, or go back to the home page.
